_documentation.model_purpose: Pre-computed Probability Lookup Table for Quality Swing Gate (T_slope x C_slope x sigma_vwap_wave)
_documentation.return_formula: P(bull) = (HH + HL) / N. Pure empirical probability based on Zigzag 2.5% stereotypes.
_documentation.horizon_gate: Point-in-time state mapping across 763,118 historical bars across 561 tickers.

field_glossary.N: Total sample size of trading days in this cell
field_glossary.p_bull: Empirical probability of bullish swing continuation (HH + HL)
field_glossary.z_score: Z-score of p_bull relative to global baseline (60.78%)
field_glossary.bias: Directional asymmetry bias label (STRONG_BULL, MILD_BULL, NEUTRAL, etc.)

_documentation.rare_event_policy: Cells with N < 30 are flagged for Empirical Bayes parent fallback to prevent overfitting.

approved_by: Committee: Dalio (CIO), Druckenmiller (Quality Swing), PTJ/Eifert (Speculative), Weinstein/Pring (Rotation)

context.what: Pre-computed probability lookup table for the Swing Gate (Quality Swing department).
context.how: Each cell describes the historical behavior of 538 tickers when the 3 dimensions (T, C, sigma_vw) align in that configuration.
context.dimensions: T_slope (Tide, long-term) x C_slope (Current, medium-term) x sigma_vwap_wave (price position vs VWAP Wave)
context.observation_unit: 1 observation = 1 bar = 1 trading day of 1 ticker. N=763,118 = 561 tickers x ~1,360 days avg each.
context.stereotype_source: Zigzag 2.5% classifies each bar as HH (Higher-High), HL (Higher-Low), LH (Lower-High), LL (Lower-Low)
context.bull_definition: Bull = HH + HL (next high or low is higher than previous)
context.bear_definition: Bear = LH + LL (next high or low is lower than previous)
context.global_p_bull_meaning: Across all 763,118 bars, 60.78% are bull. The market has structural bullish bias.

baselines._what: Baseline zigzag pivot rates across the entire market. These are the REFERENCE for all lifts and comparisons in each state.
baselines._share_denominator: share_pct in each state = count_in_state / total_pivots x 100

top_25.meaning: 77,785 2.5% zigzag tops (minor resistance) across 763,118 bars. 1 in every 10 market bars is this type of pivot.

top_50.meaning: 32,148 5.0% zigzag tops (significant resistance) across 763,118 bars. 1 in every 24 market bars is this type of pivot.

bottom_75.meaning: 17,201 7.5% zigzag bottoms (capitulations) across 763,118 bars. 1 in every 44 market bars is this type of pivot.

band_baselines._what: Each sigma_vw band groups a range of price position vs VWAP Wave. Shows WHERE the market lives and HOW it behaves at each position.
band_baselines._meaning: If lift_vs_band ~ 1.0, T and C add NO information beyond sigma_vw. If it diverges, T x C DOES discriminate within that band.
